integrity: A complete analytical proof and independent exact-rational composition checks are provided; numerical tests are finite and independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Classical unweighted Bernstein–Durrmeyer on real BV of a unit interval; integer n and positive integer iterate r. No asymmetric Jacobi weights, mixed degrees, or multivariate theorem.
title: Sharp bounded-variation norms of every Bernstein–Durrmeyer power
